title: First cotangent homology of a surjection (Stacks Tag 07BP)
statement: Let $A\twoheadrightarrow B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings with kernel $I$. Using the canonical polynomial-ring presentation and the degree-one homology convention in [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], **Stacks Tag 07BP (lemma-NL-surjection)** gives a canonical identification $$H_1(L_{B/A})\;\cong\;I/I^2.$$

mathlib_searches.query: H1 cotangent surjective ring homomorphism kernel I I quotient
mathlib_searches.verdict: partial: identifies with a cotangent kernel

mathlib_searches.results: ExtendScalars.lean:109 gives H1Cotangent ≃ Cotangent for a surjective presentation; no ideal-square quotient theorem
